title: AEGIS conformance report (frozen interface F13)
description: Signed JSON report emitted by conformance/ for a build or a third-party extension. Levels C0-C4; the golden reference claims only what its gates executed.

test_keys.description: true iff the signatures were made with per-run test keys (PLAN-6 D-P2, REL-4); absent means false. A verifier refuses a report with test_keys true unless it is run with --allow-test-keys.

signatures.description: Amended 2026-11-04 (P6-spec-001, PLAN-6 Interfaces F13; was a single `signature`; v stays 1, no consumer existed). Exactly three signatures, one per algorithm, in this order, all over the same message: the same report with the `signatures` member removed, serialized as Python json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8 (REL-1: accepted only if all three verify).

sig.description: standard base64 of the raw signature bytes
